title: 七五三の小物と場面
subject_en: Flat colourful illustrations of Shichi-Go-San (Japanese children's festival) items and scenes, each ONE object or scene centred, red and gold accents. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 千歳飴・草履・神社の鳥居など、七五三に関わる小物と場面を描いた12点です。写真台紙やお祝いのカード、案内状に使えます。
items: a long paper bag of chitose-ame candy with crane and turtle pictures but no text
a pair of red zori sandals with a brocade strap
a pair of children's wooden geta
a boy's black haori and hakama set laid out neatly
a girl's red kimono with flower patterns on a hanger
a girl's hair ornament with silk flowers and tassels
a vermilion torii gate with gravel path and a lantern
a shrine bell with a thick red and white rope
a small brocade amulet with a cord
a parent and a child in festive clothes walking toward a shrine, seen from behind
a family posing in front of a camera on a tripod, faces simple
a shrine priest waving a ritual wand over a bowing child
